theorems.name: Submission.ind_md_mass_measure_balls
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n), T.mass < ∞ → ∃ μ : Measure (Eucl P), μ univ ≤ T.mass ∧ ∀ (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), μ (ball x r) = T.massOn (ball x r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
